title: Pure Cataclysmic
summary: The Cataclysmic series consists of four Level 8 Attribute-specific Fairy monsters (FIRE, WATER, WIND, EARTH) that Special Summon themselves from the hand when a monster of their matching Attribute is destroyed by battle or card effect. Paired with Attribute-spanning destruction engines and Rank 8 Xyz monsters, they turn your own destroyed monsters into 2600 ATK beaters with bonus effects.

allow.Fire King Avatar Arvata: Level 4 FIRE monster that negates monster effects by destroying an Attribute monster in hand/field, immediately triggering the matching Cataclysmic Fairy.
allow.Unchained Twins - Aruha: Destroys a face-up Attribute monster you control to Special Summon itself, triggering the corresponding Cataclysmic Fairy in hand.
allow.Supply Squad: Continuous Spell that draws 1 card once per turn whenever a monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect.
allow.Trade-In: Discards any of the four Level 8 Cataclysmic monsters to draw 2 cards.
allow.Torrential Tribute: Destroys all monsters on the field on summon, triggering multiple Cataclysmic monsters in hand simultaneously.
allow.Coach King Giantrainer: Rank 8 Xyz made with three Level 8 Cataclysmic monsters that detaches 3 materials to draw 3 cards and burn.
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Xyz made with two Level 8 Cataclysmic monsters that negates Spells and redirects attacks.
allow.Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star: Rank 8 Xyz made with two Level 8 Cataclysmic monsters that sends an opposing card to the GY and protects your board.

main: Level 8 FIRE Fairy that Special Summons itself when a FIRE monster you control is destroyed and burns the opponent for half that monster's ATK.
Level 8 WATER Fairy that Special Summons itself when a WATER monster you control is destroyed and randomly sends 1 card from the opponent's hand to the GY.
Level 8 WIND Fairy that Special Summons itself when a WIND monster you control is destroyed and places 1 Spell/Trap on the opponent's field on top of their Deck.
Level 8 EARTH Fairy that Special Summons itself when an EARTH monster you control is destroyed and sends 1 monster from the Deck to the GY.
Negates any monster effect by destroying a FIRE or Attribute monster in hand/field, triggering Cataclysmic Scorching Sunburner.
Destroys a card you control to Special Summon itself and trigger any matching Cataclysmic monster in your hand.
Discards excess Level 8 Cataclysmic monsters to draw 2 cards.
Draws a card each turn when you destroy your own monsters to trigger Cataclysmic effects.
Wipes the board and immediately replaces your destroyed monsters with 2600 ATK Cataclysmic Fairies from your hand.
extra: Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 Xyz boss that negates Spells and protects smaller monsters from battle.
Dingirsu, the Orcust of the Evening Star
Rank 8 Xyz boss that provides non-targeting removal and prevents Torrential Tribute from destroying your own board.
Rank 8 Xyz that draws up to 3 cards using Level 8 Cataclysmic materials.
